scope: Static design/selection review scenarios; not live model accuracy or comparative performance.

cases.request: Add a short TypeScript style skill for three repeatedly missed local conventions.
acceptance: Focused instructions and clear scope suffice.
No mandatory custom floor, ledger, fleet or full gate table.
Use existing format checks and a relevant task case.

cases.request: Two skills run the same worker job with different CLI backends.
acceptance: Compare decisions, consumers and stopping conditions before splitting.
Provider-specific permissions, isolation and output rules must be preserved.
Use conditional references unless a distinct boundary is demonstrated.

cases.request: One skill constructs a candidate; another decides whether a costly test permits commitment.
acceptance: Different substantive decision and stop can justify separate owners.
Do not merge solely because both mention hypotheses.

cases.request: A new PI-named skill returns the same decision and result as an existing section role.
acceptance: New role or packet name alone does not prove independence.
Inspect the actual role boundary and existing callers.

cases.request: A skill is installed but no needed capability was used.
acceptance: Separate registration/truncation from selection and execution.
Inspect a realistic implicit request and adjacent negative.
Do not assume a missing literal keyword is the cause.

cases.request: A deployment skill activates on a request to explain an existing deployment.
acceptance: Keep explanation within the user's requested scope.
Add the realistic negative boundary.
Do not seek the highest activation rate.

cases.request: A skill installed twelve days ago has no recorded invocations.
acceptance: Inspect observation period, host coverage and stated newcomer policy.
Do not invent an industry-wide retirement age.

cases.request: A mature zero-use skill has surviving references and executable consumers.
acceptance: Inspect demand, references and invocation coverage.
Preserve or relocate required executables.
Archive outside discovery and repair consumers before claiming retirement.

cases.request: The floor sums 56000 characters and Stats attributes a billion session tokens to a skill.
acceptance: Characters are a static footprint proxy.
Session attribution does not measure manual-loading cost.
Do not convert either number into measured per-turn savings.

cases.request: A revised interruption/cleanup manual passes wording checks and one plan answer.
acceptance: Structural/static evidence does not certify interruption or cleanup.
Exercise relevant events and actual permitted actions.
Unavailable paths remain unverified.

cases.request: Turn a qualitative writing guideline into a skill.
acceptance: Preserve source scope and source-versus-local adaptation.
Do not demand invented effect sizes or causal mechanisms.

cases.request: The local manual says the default skill creators have no meaningful verification guidance.
acceptance: Inspect current creators and affected official guidance.
Historical judgments do not establish current superiority.
Reuse available guidance and tooling.
